historySource: POST /uoh-bh/v1/operations/list, from 01.01.2000T00:00:00, 100 records per page, offsets 0..7940; final empty page
detailSource: POST /uoh-bh/v1/operation/details {uohId}; protocol from installed APK ohf.a; complete actual currency transfer response retained
feeSemantics: operationAmount is principal; commission is an additional account-currency debit. nationalAmount includes the fee in newer records but repeats principal in 30 old UfsOutTransfer records. Adjacent balances independently verify 8 of those old records. TakingMeans is a separate booked charge with no commission field and stays a standalone movement. No incoming nonzero fee or combined FX/fee example was observed.
currencyTransfer: 28.04.2025: bank confirms USD debit and RUB credit. Historical USD source is absent from the complete current graph, so it is a reference by data, not a fabricated current account. Credit comes from detail field Сумма в валюте зачисления; billingAmount is a balance, not credit. Two currently fetched different-currency accounts were not observed together.
sanitization: Complete selected source objects; consistent IDs across graph, history and details; personal/free text and account/card suffixes replaced preserving structure, dates, currencies and amounts. Protocol field labels retained.

nativeValidation.scope: Current native synchronization window; historical fee and FX cases separately validated against complete bank history/detail responses and the mobile adapter. The current phone window contains neither a nonzero fee nor this historical FX transfer.
nativeValidation.revisionScope: Native validation predates the external-counterparty repair; the repaired outputs are verified offline against these complete bank records and the mobile adapter.

externalTransferRegression.source: Existing complete sanitized operations retained unchanged; real incoming transfers, outgoing transfers with/without fees, and absent counterparty resources are selected by observed form and state.
externalTransferRegression.expectedResults: The previous independent principal/fee/date/merchant ledger is retained. Add the counterparty movement from its actual masked resource: opposite principal, zero fee, null movement ID, unknown type/company, observed suffix. Resource currency is absent in these records; use invoice currency if present, otherwise local account currency. No exchange rate or external account balance is inferred.
externalTransferRegression.scope: Only observed transfer forms with a known masked resource outside the represented graph gain an external side. Current captures contain RUB external transfers; a distinct confirmed external currency is not present. Operations without such a resource, internal transfers, cash, and local movement identities are preserved.
